reason: The cited evidence supports L12 precipitation and strengthening in Al0.7CoCrFeNi, but it does not provide data on ductility improvement, reduction of dislocation pile-ups, or achieving >20% elongation; the key premise that annealing overcomes brittleness is unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Low-temperature annealing of Al0.7CoCrFeNi precipitates coherent L12 nanoparticles in the FCC lamellae
L12 precipitates strengthen the alloy via Orowan bowing/bypass
L12 precipitation does not significantly degrade ductility
The intervention reduces dislocation pile-ups at internal boundaries
The treatment increases room-temperature tensile ductility from ~8% to >20% while maintaining or increasing yield strength
